title: CNP Notification 2026 - Walk-in-Interview for Consultant Posts
description: Currency Note Press, Nashik (CNP Nashik), has declared the official notification for the recruitment of 01 consultant position. Candidates who have qualified in B.E/ B.Tech or a Diploma in Civil Engineering can use this opportunity and apply for the CNP Notification 2026 . Here are the age limit, selection process, salary structure, education details, application fee, and how to apply for these posts.
